title: QA Architect
jobDescription:
Job Description – Quality Engineering Architect (QA Architect) Primary Skills Quality Engineering Architecture, API & Contract Testing, Banking Payments , Automation Framework Development, Performance & Resilience Testing, Security Testing, AI-assisted Test Automation, Test Strategy, Software Quality Management, Technical Leadership Experience: 10–15 Years Role Summary The Quality Engineering Architect will define and drive the enterprise Quality Engineering strategy across banking and payment platforms. This role is responsible for designing scalable test architectures, automation frameworks, API and contract testing standards, workflow-level validation, performance and security testing practices, AI-enabled Quality Engineering capabilities, and CI/CD quality gates to ensure high-quality, resilient, compliant, and scalable software delivery. With a strong focus on regulated Banking and Financial Services environments, the role emphasizes scheme conformance, Payment Messages, Payment rails , audit-ready compliance evidence, and engineering excellence. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. The architect is expected to actively contribute to automation framework development, write production-quality code, mentor engineering teams, and drive enterprise-wide Quality Engineering transformation — not operate solely in a governance capacity. Key Responsibilities Own the enterprise Quality Engineering roadmap and define testing standards, frameworks, governance models, and engineering best practices. Lead scheme conformance and regulatory compliance testing for Banking Payments and Banking Applications
- based integrations. Design and build API-first and contract-first automation frameworks using tools such as Karate, Pact, Specmatic, Wire Mock, Rest Assured, or equivalent. Drive workflow-level testing for orchestration platforms (Temporal, Camunda, Conductor, or equivalent), covering replay validation, determinism, compensation, and idempotency. Establish testing strategies for event-driven, asynchronous, and distributed payment workflows. Design and maintain container-based integration testing environments using Testcontainers or equivalent technologies. Define test data management strategies for regulated environments, including synthetic data generation, masking, and privacy-safe provisioning. Implement release evidence automation and end-to-end traceability (Requirements → Test Cases → Executions → Defects) to support audit readiness and regulatory compliance. Define security testing practices and integrate Dev Sec Ops quality controls within CI/CD pipelines. Define performance, scalability, resilience, and reliability testing strategies for production-scale payment systems. Integrate automated quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and establish release readiness criteria. Drive AI-assisted Quality Engineering by leveraging intelligent test generation, regression optimization, self-healing automation, flaky test detection, and change-impact-based test selection. Evaluate emerging Quality Engineering technologies and continuously improve engineering practices across the organization. Mentor Quality Engineers and provide technical leadership across automation, API testing, workflow validation, compliance testing, and engineering excellence. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Dev Ops, Security, and Business teams to embed quality throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).. Must-Have Skills Quality Engineering & Architecture 10–15 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Architecture, or QA Automation with demonstrated ownership of enterprise Quality Engineering strategy. Experience designing scalable automation frameworks and reusable Quality Engineering platforms. Experience implementing end-to-end traceability and producing audit-ready release evidence. Strong understanding of quality governance, risk-based testing, defect prevention, and release quality management. Automation & Testing Strong expertise in API testing, API automation, and contract testing, with hands-on experience in tools such as Karate, Pact, Specmatic, Wire Mock, Rest Assured, or equivalent. Experience with Playwright or equivalent modern automation frameworks. Strong understanding of microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven/asynchronous architectures, including experience testing workflow orchestration platforms (Temporal, Camunda, Conductor, or equivalent) for replay, determinism, compensation, and idempotency. Experience with Testcontainers or equivalent container-based integration testing approaches. Experience defining and executing performance, scalability, resilience, and load testing using JMeter, Gatling, or equivalent tools. Experience with security testing methodologies, Dev Sec Ops practices, and strong SQL/database validation skills.. Banking & Payments Strong experience in Banking Payments, payment processing platforms, or transaction processing systems. Exposure to message standards and scheme conformance testing is strongly preferred. Good understanding of transaction lifecycle, reconciliation, settlement, and regulatory compliance testing. Dev Ops & Engineering Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using Azure Dev Ops, Jenkins, Git Lab, or equivalent platforms. Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, containerized applications, and cloud-native testing. Experience managing test data in regulated environments using synthetic data generation, masking, and secure provisioning. Strong hands-on programming experience in C#/.NET (preferred) or Java using x Unit/NUnit, JUnit, or equivalent testing frameworks. Candidates must actively contribute to automation framework development and demonstrate coding proficiency during the technical assessment. Experience working in Agile, Dev Ops, and regulated software delivery environments. AI-enabled Quality Engineering Experience leveraging AI-assisted testing tools to improve software quality and engineering productivity. Experience with intelligent test generation, regression optimization, self-healing automation, flaky-test detection, change-impact analysis, and AI-assisted test maintenance. Leadership Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Proven ability to mentor, coach, and build high-performing Quality Engineering teams. Experience driving engineering excellence across multiple products, platforms, and delivery teams. Good-to-Have Skills Accessibility testing. Service virtualization and advanced contract testing practices. Mobile automation testing. ISTQB Advanced Test Architect (or equivalent) certification. title: Lead Engineer QA-(Automation, API, Performance, Security)
jobDescription:
Job Description Job Title Lead Software Test Engineer – Manual & Automation Testing Job Summary We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Lead Software Test Engineer to lead the Quality Assurance function for enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for defining the QA strategy, leading a team of test engineers, driving automation initiatives, ensuring release quality, and collaborating with business and technology teams throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). The role requires extensive experience in manual and automation testing, test planning, quality governance, defect management, API testing, database validation, Agile delivery, and mentoring QA teams. The successful candidate will play a key role in establishing testing best practices, improving automation maturity, and ensuring high-quality software delivery. Key Responsibilities Lead the QA team and oversee all testing activities across multiple projects and releases. Proven hands-on experience in designing and developing automation frameworks from scratch , Define and implement the overall Test Strategy, Test Plan, Test Approach, and Quality Assurance processes. Review business requirements, functional specifications, and technical designs to ensure complete test coverage. Plan, estimate, assign, and monitor testing activities to ensure timely project delivery. Lead functional, integration, system, regression, API, database, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing support. Design, develop, review, and maintain automation frameworks and automated test suites using Selenium and Playwright. Drive automation adoption and continuously improve test coverage and execution efficiency. Ensure effective defect lifecycle management using Azure Dev Ops and facilitate defect triage meetings. Manage test environments, test data, test execution schedules, and release validation activities. Review test cases, automation scripts, and test results to ensure compliance with quality standards. Track and report testing progress, defect metrics, automation coverage, quality KPIs, and release readiness to project stakeholders. Identify project risks, quality issues, and dependencies, and provide mitigation plans. Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, Developers, Dev Ops Engineers, and Project Managers. Mentor, coach, and technically guide QA team members while conducting code reviews for automation scripts. Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning. Evaluate and recommend testing tools, automation frameworks, and QA best practices. Support CI/CD implementation by integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality, testing efficiency, and team productivity. Stay current with emerging technologies, software testing trends, and industry best practices. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 8–12 years of experience in Software Testing, with at least 2–3 years in a QA Lead or Test Lead role . Proven hands-on experience in designing and developing automation frameworks from scratch , Proven experience leading QA teams in Agile/Scrum environments. Strong experience in Manual Testing and Automation Testing. Hands-on experience with Selenium Web Driver using Java or .NET. Experience with Playwright automation. Strong knowledge of Test Automation Framework design and maintenance. Experience with API testing using Postman and REST API automation. Strong SQL skills for database validation and backend testing. Hands-on experience with Azure Dev Ops for Test Management, Work Item Management, Sprint Planning, and Defect Tracking. Experience working with Git / Azure Repos. Good understanding of STLC, SDLC, defect management, release management, and quality assurance processes. Experience with Agile methodologies and Scrum ceremonies. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills. Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Primary Technical Skills Manual Testing Automation Testing Selenium Web Driver Selenium with Java or .NET Playwright Test Automation Framework Development API Testing (Postman) REST API Automation SQL Azure Dev Ops Git / Azure Repos Agile / Scrum JMeter (Performance Testing) Good to Have Experience in the Banking or Financial Services (BFSI) domain. Knowledge of Core Banking Systems and Banking Operations. Familiarity with Payment Systems such as UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, SWIFT, and ISO
20022. Understanding of Banking Regulatory Compliance and Financial Transaction Processing. Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure Dev Ops Pipelines, Jenkins, Git Hub Actions, etc.). Experience with Performance Testing using JMeter. Experience in API Automation using Rest Assured or similar frameworks. Exposure to Security Testing concepts. Experience working with cloud platforms (Azure preferred). ISTQB Advanced Level Certification or equivalent QA certifications. Leadership Competencies Strong leadership and people management skills. Experience in mentoring and developing QA engineers. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. Strong stakeholder management and client communication skills. Excellent planning, estimation, and resource management capabilities. Data-driven decision-making using QA metrics and KPIs. Strong risk management and problem-solving skills. Ability to drive continuous improvement and quality transformation initiatives. jobDescription:

title: Lead Engineer-Technical Product Owner – Medical Device Software
jobDescription:
Key Responsibilities As a Technical Product Owner, you will: Own the Software Backlog : Lead and manage the product backlog for medical device software component. Translate Vision to Execution : Transform complex clinical, business, and user needs into clear user stories, requirements, and functional specs that drive development. Drive Cross-Functional Alignment : Collaborate closely with software engineers, QA, UX designers, systems engineers, and regulatory teams to ensure cohesive, high-quality delivery. Prioritize for Impact : Make data-informed decisions to balance development, technical debt, and regulatory considerations—ensuring high product value and compliance. Ensure Scalable Architecture : Partner with system architects to develop solutions that are scalable, secure, and maintainable. Maintain Regulatory Rigor : Contribute to risk management activities including hazard analysis, design traceability, and documentation in compliance with IEC 62304 and ISO
14971. Lead Agile Execution : Facilitate Agile ceremonies—sprint planning, backlog grooming, cross-functional syncs—ensuring on-time, compliant software releases. Required Qualifications

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience : 10+ years in software product development, with at least 3 years in a Product Owner or technical leadership role. Regulatory SDLC Expertise : Deep knowledge of software development within regulated or safety-critical environments. Agile Experience : Proven experience delivering software using Agile/Scrum frameworks, with strong documentation skills. Medical Device Standards : Solid understanding of IEC 62304, ISO 13485, FDA, MDR, and related standards. Communication : Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with a collaborative, cross-functional mindset. Preferred Qualifications Domain Experience : Background in medical devices, diagnostics, surgical systems, or ophthalmology. Technical Background : Hands-on experience in software development, with preferred proficiency in C++. Cybersecurity Acumen : Familiarity with secure software development and frameworks such as FDA Premarket Cybersecurity Guidance and ISO/IEC
27001. Cutting-Edge Innovation : Work on advanced medical devices and imaging systems that are transforming surgical precision and patient care. Security-First Culture : Be part of a team that prioritizes cybersecurity and patient safety , with a strong focus on secure software development and regulatory excellence. Global Collaboration : Collaborate with expert teams in Germany, the U.S., and across the globe on high-impact, next-gen healthcare solutions. People-Centric Leadership : Grow in a culture that values mentorship, learning , and long-term career development . Stability & Purpose : Join a 175-year-old brand that combines legacy, stability , and cutting-edge innovation with a clear mission to make a difference in people’s lives.
